issue.title: Priority, task-tag, freshness, and Today-off body-class gates do not reach Obsidian popout windows
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.3 (popout-mark-gates, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2); triaged and widened by the batch-11 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.land) after a source audit on bob-plugins master 04c61c7.

Batch 11 fixed bob-cli-9q for three mark families by adding the shared `BobLedgerToolsMarkGateMixin` (`plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/266-plugin-mark-gate-mirror.js`: `applyMarkGateClass` + `registerMarkGatePopoutSync`), which mirrors each gate class onto the main body, every markdown leaf's container document, and every `window-open` popout document. The remaining bob-ledger-tools body-class gates still write only the main window's `document.body`, so they do not hold in Obsidian popout windows, which own a separate `<body>`:

- `bob-priority-marks` (positive gate, 11 rules in `styles.css` ~1136-1200): set in `265-plugin-priority-marks.js` setup (~line 25) and toggle (~857). In a popout, Tasks-result priority components fall back to Tasks' default emoji instead of bob's priority glyphs.
- `bob-task-tag-marks` (positive gate, ~30 rules from `styles.css` ~1511): set in `264-plugin-task-tag-marks.js` (~23, ~675). Task tag marks lose their styling in popouts.
- `bob-fresh-marks` (positive gate, `styles.css` ~455): set in `250-plugin-freshness-mark-model.js` (~16) and `260-plugin-freshness-mark-render.js` (~563). Freshness inline-field styling is missing in popouts.
- `bob-today-marks-off` (opt-out gate): set in `275-plugin-today-marks.js` (~86, ~623). Today marks show by default in popouts, but toggling them off does not reach popouts.

Root cause: identical to bob-cli-9q. Each setup/toggle touches `document.body` only. Fix: route each setup and toggle through `applyMarkGateClass(<class>, <enabled>)` and register `registerMarkGatePopoutSync(<class>, () => <enabled>)` once per family, as 266/268/271 now do. For the opt-out class, pass the "off" state as enabled. Add a "holds in popout windows for both toggle states" test per family, following the batch-11 tests in `scripts/test-ledger-tools-{date,progress}-marks.cjs` and `scripts/test-ledger-tools-unblocked-glyph.cjs`. Run `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run validate`, then deploy with `bob plugins sync`.

`bob-dep-chips` (`280-plugin-dependency-render.js`) has no CSS gate in `styles.css` and is out of scope unless a rule keyed on it appears.

task_type_fields.impact: Read-time mark styling silently differs between the main window and popouts; toggle-off of Today marks is ignored in popouts. Low severity unless Bryan uses popout windows.
task_type_fields.location: bob-plugins plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/{250,260,264,265,275}-*.js setup/toggle body-class writes (bob-priority-marks, bob-task-tag-marks, bob-fresh-marks, bob-today-marks-off)
task_type_fields.repro: Open a note containing a Tasks query result with priorities (or task tags / fresh inline fields) in an Obsidian popout window (right-click tab -> Open in new window). Inspect the popout <body> classList: bob-priority-marks / bob-task-tag-marks / bob-fresh-marks are absent while the main window has them, so priority glyphs, tag marks, and freshness styling render unstyled in the popout. Toggle Today marks off: the main body gains bob-today-marks-off, the popout body does not.

issue.creation_reason: Batch 11's popout-mark-gates phase fixed three mark families with a shared popout mirror and proposed this follow-up; a lander audit found four more bob-ledger-tools body-class gates with the same main-window-only root cause.

payload.description: Same main-window-only body-class root cause; 9q's batch-11 fix added the BobLedgerToolsMarkGateMixin this task should reuse
need task scope for popout mark gates phase

payload.entry: Fixed by batch-13 phase popout-mark-gates (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.2), bob-plugins 756a368. bob-priority-marks, bob-task-tag-marks, bob-fresh-marks, and bob-today-marks-off now use BobLedgerToolsMarkGateMixin applyMarkGateClass on setup and toggle (the off class passes !enabled) plus registerMarkGatePopoutSync. Each family has a holds-in-popout-windows test covering both toggle states. Phase: npm test 3739/0, build, and validate green. Lander rerun on master 457db03 (rebased onto 756a368 with 14l's Day strip theme lane): priority 18/0, task-tag 27/0, freshness surfaces 19/0, today 42/0; build:check current. Concurrent agent 14l had redeployed a pre-rebase 1.74.0 build without these gates at 12:23. The lander redeployed 457db03 with bob plugins sync -p bob-ledger-tools: vault main.js, manifest, and styles are byte-identical to master, with 7 popout-synced gate families and 0 drift. Mac also runs 457db03 (7 gates). Apollo's plugin checkout is still at 24bfdb2 and picks this up on its next install. bob-dep-chips has no CSS body gate, so it stays out of scope.
